title: Original (control)
intent: The narration exactly as scripts/narration.json has it, word for word. Control for every comparison.
notes: Line texts are the literal TTS input of the existing pipeline, including its respellings ("ce más más", "i ce pe ce", "Uceva"). `caption` is the correct spelling shown on screen (src/timeline.ts). No pronunciation hints are applied, so that this script stays the unmodified baseline.
